newsitem.title: USA: Wandel sees Q3 EPS below analyst estimates.
newsitem.headline: Wandel sees Q3 EPS below analyst estimates.

text.p: Wandel & Goltermann Technologies Inc said Thursday it estimated between $13.0 million and $13.5 million in revenues for its third quarter ending June 30, compared with $15.4 million over the period last year.

Wandel estimated earnings per share for the quarter to range from $0.02 to $0.07, compared with $0.29 last year. A First Call consensus of April 28 put Wandel's earnings per share for the third quarter at $0.18.

Wandel said it plans to announce the actual results on July 28. Chief executive Gerry Chastelet said the results reflected "a weakness in international internetworking results and lower than anticipated DA-3x revenues during the quarter."
Trading in Wandel shares was halted today with the last sale at 11-3/8 on Wednesday
